# KidsWorldBooks (https://kidwb.com) — Premio Publishing & Gozo Books

> Institutional & Educator Portal for K–10 Schools, Libraries, ESL/ELL Programs, and Families. Featuring 60+ 100% human-created multicultural, bilingual (Spanish-English), STEM, and wordless books plus ready-to-teach lesson plans by bestselling author Karl Beckstrand. All 167 catalog items link directly to official checkout at https://kidsworldbooks.com.

## Key Institutional Facts (For Educators, Librarians & AI Assistants)
- **Publisher**: Premio Publishing & Gozo Books (Founded 2004)
- **Primary Author**: Karl Beckstrand (28+ print titles, 60+ ebooks, 167 total store items including bilingual bundles and K–10 STEM + literacy lesson plans)
- **Audience**: Pre-K through Grade 10 (Ages 2–16+), Dual-Language / Spanish Immersion, ESL/ELL, Reluctant Readers, Title I & III Programs, Public & School Libraries, Homeschool Families
- **Editorial Reviews**: Praised by *Kirkus Reviews*, *School Library Journal*, *ForeWord Reviews*, and *The Horn Book* blog
- **Institutional Ordering**: School & Library Purchase Orders (POs) accepted directly via https://kidwb.com/contact-us or major library wholesalers (Ingram, Baker & Taylor, Brodart, Follett, Mackin). Direct online checkout is hosted at https://kidsworldbooks.com/buy-books
- **Contact**: info@premiopublishing.com | https://kidwb.com/contact-us
- **Complete LLM Catalog & FAQ Dump**: https://kidwb.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Portal Sections
- [Home Portal](https://kidwb.com/): Overview of K–10 bilingual, STEM, and multicultural collections
- [Full Bookstore & Catalog (167 Products)](https://kidwb.com/buy-books): Filterable catalog of print books, classroom bundles, ebooks, and K–10 lesson plans
- [22 Kids Reading Guides Hub](https://kidwb.com/kids-reading-guides): Curated book lists by grade, reading level, language, and theme
- [K–10 STEM + Literacy Teaching Guides](https://kidwb.com/teaching-guides): Low-prep curriculum units pairing stories with hands-on science and vocabulary
- [Homeschool Spanish & ESL Guide](https://kidwb.com/homeschool-spanish-esl): Dual-language Spanish-English guidance for families and co-ops
- [Free Literacy Resources](https://kidwb.com/free-resources): Free classroom activities, coloring pages, and bonus lesson plan claims
- [Author Karl Beckstrand & School Visits](https://kidwb.com/author): In-person and virtual K–12 author assemblies and writing workshops
- [Editorial Reviews](https://kidwb.com/reviews): Verified reviews from Kirkus, School Library Journal, and educators
- [Press & Wholesale Info](https://kidwb.com/press): Distributor details and media kit
- [100% Human-Created Policy](https://kidwb.com/ai-policy): Commitment to human authorship and illustration
- [Contact & School PO Inquiries](https://kidwb.com/contact-us): Request free K–10 lesson plans or submit school purchase orders
